member_descriptions.name: api_anthropic_claude
member_descriptions.title: Anthropic Claude
member_descriptions.description: Input your query or image for analysis. Generate a natural language response powered by Anthropic Claude, supporting both text conversation and image understanding.

member_descriptions.name: api_anthropic_claude_fable5
member_descriptions.title: Claude: Fable 5
member_descriptions.description: Claude Fable 5, Anthropic's first public Mythos-class frontier model, powers end-to-end creative workflows in ComfyUI. It takes 1 text prompt and generates 1 structured output including storyboard breakdowns, precise prompts for SD models and ControlNet, and custom node scripts. Ideal for concept artists refining visual narratives, AI filmmakers maintaining style consistency across series, and digital creators automating their entire rendering pipeline.

member_descriptions.name: api_anthropic_claude_fable5_1
member_descriptions.title: Claude: Fable 5.1
member_descriptions.description: Run Claude Fable 5.1, Anthropic's frontier coding and agentic research model, directly in your workflow to tackle long-running, multi-step problems with state-of-the-art reasoning. This template provides access to the model's full capabilities, from root-cause software debugging and complex code generation to scientific analysis and knowledge work, with adjustable effort levels to balance cost and performance. Ideal for autonomous coding agents, deep technical investigations, and extended research tasks that require sustained, high-quality output.

member_descriptions.name: api_anthropic_claude_opus_5
member_descriptions.title: Claude: Opus 5
member_descriptions.description: Load an image and enter a prompt to interact with Claude Opus 5, a highly capable and cost-efficient AI model that excels at coding, knowledge work, and problem-solving. Ideal for software engineering tasks, scientific research requiring visual analysis, and everyday productivity with a thoughtful, proactive assistant.

member_descriptions.name: api_anthropic_claude_opus_5_5
member_descriptions.title: Claude: Opus 5.5
member_descriptions.description: This workflow pairs a single uploaded image with a text prompt, sending both to Claude Opus 5.5 for multimodal reasoning and response generation. Ideal for image captioning, visual question answering, and prompt-driven image analysis.

member_descriptions.name: api_anthropic_claude_sonnet5
member_descriptions.title: Claude: Sonnet 5
member_descriptions.description: Leverage Claude Sonnet 5 for high-value autonomous task execution, bridging the gap to flagship performance at a lower cost. Input any text prompt or script to generate precise image descriptions, automated workflow scripts, shot sequence logs, or node logic corrections. Ideal for batch production tasks, debugging ComfyUI node logic, and maintaining consistent output quality across repetitive generation workflows.

member_descriptions.name: api_beeble_switchx_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: Relight: Beeble SwitchX
member_descriptions.description: Upload your character image and a reference style/lighting image. Generate an edited output with the reference lighting and style applied to your original image.

member_descriptions.name: api_bria_eraser
member_descriptions.title: Object Removal: Bria Eraser
member_descriptions.description: Remove unwanted objects or regions from images with Bria's Eraser, which fills the masked area with surrounding context while leaving the rest of the image pixel-perfect. Upload 1 image, paint over the target object with a brush mask, and receive 1 cleaned output alongside a before-and-after comparison. Ideal for cleaning up photobombs, removing watermarks or text, and decluttering product or real-estate photos.

member_descriptions.name: api_bria_expand_image
member_descriptions.title: Image Outpainting: Bria
member_descriptions.description: Expand an image beyond its original borders using Bria's outpainting API, generating new surrounding content that matches the original lighting, perspective, and texture while leaving the source untouched. Choose from preset aspect ratios, custom dimensions, or manual canvas placement, with optional text prompts to guide the expansion direction or an auto-generated prompt when left blank. Ideal for extending compositions for print layouts, creating panoramic versions of existing photos, and adapting artwork to new formats or social media dimensions.

member_descriptions.name: api_bria_genfill
member_descriptions.title: Inpainting: Bria Generative Fill
member_descriptions.description: Use Bria's Generative Fill API to regenerate a specific region of an image while keeping everything outside the mask pixel-perfect unchanged. Paint a mask over the target area, write a detailed prompt for the replacement content, and compare the before/after side-by-side before exporting. Ideal for product photography corrections, object removal or replacement, and creative compositing where precise control over the edited region matters.

member_descriptions.name: api_bria_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: Bria: FIBO 2.0 Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit an image with Bria FIBO 2.0 by describing the change in plain language, with an optional mask to confine it to one region. FIBO 2.0 is one model for both editing and generation, trained on structured VGL captions, so it holds everything you did not ask to change, and it returns that structured prompt so the edit can be rebuilt or refined from JSON.

member_descriptions.name: api_bria_product_holding
member_descriptions.title: Bria: Product Holding
member_descriptions.description: Place a product into the hands of the person in a photo with Bria. One person photo plus one to three product shots is enough for a lifestyle image in which the face, pose and background stay untouched and the product is held naturally. Ideal for e-commerce and social content that would otherwise need a shoot.

member_descriptions.name: api_bria_virtual_try_on
member_descriptions.title: Bria: Virtual Try-On
member_descriptions.description: Dress the person in a photo with a garment from a separate product shot using Bria. One person photo plus one to three garments or accessories produces a worn look in which the face, pose and background stay untouched and the garment is refitted to the body. Ideal for fashion catalogs and lookbooks without a photoshoot.

member_descriptions.name: api_bytedance_seed
member_descriptions.title: ByteDance: Seed 2.0
member_descriptions.description: Input an image or video for analysis. Receive detailed text output describing visual content, reasoning, and structured information extraction.

member_descriptions.name: api_from_photo_2_miniature
member_descriptions.title: Photo to Blueprint to Model
member_descriptions.description: Transform real building photos into architectural blueprints and then into detailed physical scale models. A complete architectural visualization pipeline from photo to miniature.

member_descriptions.name: api_grok_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: Grok: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Upload an image to edit with the Grok model. Generate a modified version with expressive, cinematic visuals

member_descriptions.name: api_grok_imagine_image_2_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: Grok Imagine Image 2.0: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Grok Imagine Image 2.0 performs precise image editing and text rendering using xAI's Aurora engine, letting you modify specific elements, swap backgrounds, or restyle scenes through natural language with crisp short-text output. It takes up to 3 reference images and generates at 1K or 2K resolution across 14 aspect ratios, with strong character consistency across scenes. Ideal for poster and cover design, product and brand visuals, or multi-scene character workflows.

member_descriptions.name: api_grok_imagine_image_quality_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: Grok Imagine Image Quality: Edit
member_descriptions.description: Enhance image quality with advanced text rendering and creative control using Grok Imagine Image Quality. Input images or prompts for improved detail and fidelity.

member_descriptions.name: api_i2i_imageEdit_OpenAi_GPT2
member_descriptions.description: [API] image edit via GPT Image 2. 1 input image -> 1 output image. Pick this for cloud-based editing using OpenAI's API.

member_descriptions.name: api_luma_photon_i2i
member_descriptions.title: Luma Photon: Image to Image
member_descriptions.description: Guide image generation using a combination of images and prompt.

member_descriptions.name: api_luma_photon_style_ref
member_descriptions.title: Luma Photon: Style Reference
member_descriptions.description: Generate images by blending style references with precise control using Luma Photon.

member_descriptions.name: api_luma_uni_1_image_create
member_descriptions.title: Luma UNI-1: Image Creation
member_descriptions.description: Generate brand-new original images using the Luma UNI-1 node with up to 9 reference images for style, character, color, lighting, and composition. Create unique compositions with detailed prompts, adjustable aspect ratios, and seed control.

member_descriptions.name: api_luma_uni_1_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: Luma UNI-1: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit existing images with Uni-1's Image Edit mode, preserving composition and core elements. Supports targeted adjustments like lighting and color using prompts and reference images.

member_descriptions.name: api_meta_muse_image_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: Muse Image 1.0: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit an image with precision using Muse Image 1.0, following natural language instructions to alter specific elements while preserving the rest of the scene. Takes 2 input images and produces 1 edited output image. Ideal for product photography touch-ups, creative style transfers, and iterative visual refinement.

member_descriptions.name: api_openai_chat
member_descriptions.title: OpenAI: ChatGPT
member_descriptions.description: Engage with OpenAI's advanced language models for intelligent conversations.

member_descriptions.name: api_openai_fashion_billboard_generator
member_descriptions.title: Fashion Billboard Generator
member_descriptions.description: Transform clothing photos into professional mall billboard advertisements featuring realistic fashion models.

member_descriptions.name: api_openai_gpt6_astra
member_descriptions.title: GPT-6 Astra
member_descriptions.description: Generate polished visual assets and optimize image-analysis prompts with GPT-6 Astra, an AI model that excels at computer vision tasks while adapting to your preferred style and reference images. Input your source visuals and creative direction to receive refined, immediately usable outputs with accurate detail and concise messaging. Ideal for enhancing prompt engineering workflows, preparing image datasets for analysis, and producing presentation-ready visual content that meets professional standards.

member_descriptions.name: api_openai_gpt_image_25_flare_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: GPT Image 2.5 Flare: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Template for image rework & partial modification. Keep scene, pose, lighting and composition unchanged, only edit outfit, hairstyle or local details. Fast preview and iterative style adjustment powered by GPT-Image-2.5-Flare.

member_descriptions.name: api_openai_gpt_image_25_sunburst_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: High-fidelity image editing template. Preserve original character pose, scene, lighting and composition. Only modify partial elements such as outfit, hairstyle, facial features or camera angle. Great for sequential frame generation with strong subject consistency.

member_descriptions.name: api_openai_gpt_image_2_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: GPT Image 2: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Upload a reference image and write a prompt to create campaign-ready posters, product shots, and multilingual signage. The model renders clean text and photorealistic outputs suitable for commercial work.

member_descriptions.name: api_openai_image_1_i2i
member_descriptions.title: OpenAI: GPT-Image-1 Image to Image
member_descriptions.description: Generate images from input images using OpenAI GPT Image 1 API.

member_descriptions.name: api_openai_image_1_multi_inputs
member_descriptions.title: OpenAI: GPT-Image-1 Multi Inputs
member_descriptions.description: Generate images from multiple inputs using OpenAI GPT Image 1 API.

member_descriptions.name: api_openrouter_gpt5_6_luna
member_descriptions.title: GPT-5.6 Luna
member_descriptions.description: GPT-5.6 Luna streamlines visual pre-production by analyzing a single reference image and generating structured creative text from a user prompt. It takes 1 input image and produces no explicit visual outputs, focusing instead on rapid, standardized copywriting. Ideal for batch scene description expansion, shot list organization, and high-volume creative ideation.

member_descriptions.name: api_openrouter_gpt5_6_sol
member_descriptions.title: GPT-5.6: Sol
member_descriptions.description: GPT-5.6 Sol is a multimodal model workflow for visual storytelling, taking 1 input image and a user prompt to generate detailed scene descriptions and narrative sequences. Ideal for world-building, multi-shot storyboarding, and maintaining consistent art style across long-form illustration or video projects.

member_descriptions.name: api_openrouter_gpt5_6_terra
member_descriptions.title: GPT-5.6 Terra
member_descriptions.description: Describe a scene or world using GPT-5.6 Terra, a balanced multimodal model that interprets one uploaded image to guide visual storytelling and style consistency. Ideal for worldbuilding, mood board creation, and maintaining cohesive aesthetics across a series of works.

member_descriptions.name: api_openrouter_grok4_5
member_descriptions.title: Grok: Grok 4.5
member_descriptions.description: Grok 4.5 is a flagship multimodal model designed for complex engineering and creative tasks, with native visual parsing and high-speed inference. It takes creative briefs and generated images as inputs, producing standardized scene descriptions and iterative visual analysis. Ideal for multi-shot storyboarding, batch image description generation, and feedback-driven creative refinement.

member_descriptions.name: api_openrouter_kimi_k3
member_descriptions.title: Kimi: K3
member_descriptions.description: Generate detailed image descriptions and creative briefs using Kimi K3, a multimodal model with million-token context windows for unified text and image understanding. Input one image and a text prompt to produce nuanced visual analyses or batch descriptions. Ideal for streamlining multi-shot visual series, generating automated script prompts for node-based workflows, and iteratively refining creative concepts through image feedback.

member_descriptions.name: api_openrouter_mai_image_26_flash_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: MAI Image 2.6 Flash: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit images with MAI Image 2.6 Flash, Microsoft's fast image-to-image model that transforms a single input image into a refined output. Ideal for quick retouching, style adjustments, and rapid concept iteration.

member_descriptions.name: api_openrouter_mai_image_26_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: MAI Image 2.6: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit images with MAI Image 2.6, Microsoft's flagship model for image editing, combining two reference images into a single refined output. Ideal for multi-reference compositing, product visual restyling, and text-in-image design work.

member_descriptions.name: api_quiver_arrow2_image_to_svg
member_descriptions.title: Arrow2: Image to SVG
member_descriptions.description: Convert a raster image into a clean, editable SVG vector using Arrow 2, taking one image and returning one vector output. The model produces cleaner geometry and stronger composition with fewer control points. Ideal for vectorizing sketches, logos, and line art, or preparing scalable brand and product assets.

member_descriptions.name: api_quiver_image_to_svg
member_descriptions.title: Arrow 2: Image to SVG
member_descriptions.description: Converts an image input into an SVG output.

member_descriptions.name: api_recraft_style_reference
member_descriptions.title: Recraft Style Reference Generation
member_descriptions.description: Upload multiple images to create a consistent style reference. Generate new images using this reference to maintain visual coherence across outputs.

member_descriptions.name: api_recraft_v4_style_reference
member_descriptions.title: Recraft V4: Style-Reference Image Generation
member_descriptions.description: Generate images in the style of one or more reference images using Recraft V4 Styles, capturing texture, composition, and rendering without any training or fine-tuning. Feed in multiple reference images to sharpen or broaden the style match, and receive a single styled output. Ideal for brand-consistent asset creation, matching a client's existing campaign look, or adapting styles from any external image source.

member_descriptions.name: api_runway_reference_to_image
member_descriptions.title: Runway: Reference to Image
member_descriptions.description: Generate new images based on reference styles and compositions with Runway's AI.

member_descriptions.name: api_runway_text_to_image
member_descriptions.title: Runway: Text to Image
member_descriptions.description: Generate high-quality images from text prompts using Runway's AI model.

member_descriptions.name: api_tencent_hy_image_3_5_preview_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: HY Image 3.5 Preview: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit images with the HY Image 3.5 Preview model, which deeply understands user intent through optimized text-and-image organization to deliver high-quality results. Takes 1 image input and produces 1 image output. Ideal for portrait editing, commercial posters, and film/TV marketing materials.

member_descriptions.name: api_wavespeed_seedvr2_ai_image_fix
member_descriptions.title: Image Upscale: WaveSpeed SeedVR2
member_descriptions.description: Upload an AI-generated image to restore details and upscale. The workflow preserves colors and sharpness while minimizing artifacts. Output is a high-quality, enlarged version of your input.

member_descriptions.name: rain_platform_storyboard
member_descriptions.description: [API] Storyboard generation via gpt-image-2.5-flare. Eight image refs -> Final image. Use this to batch-create consistent panels from a set of visual inputs.

member_descriptions.name: template-recraft_create_style
member_descriptions.title: Style Transfer - Recraft Text-to-Image
member_descriptions.description: Upload 1-5 style references and create a style ID to generate consistent, on brand images.

member_descriptions.name: template_contact_sheet-step_1.app
member_descriptions.title: Step 1: Contact Sheet Workflow
member_descriptions.description: Upload your character, scene and product. Integrates all images into a fashion editorial style photograph.

member_descriptions.name: template_eric_seedance_5_subject_and_outfit_combine
member_descriptions.title: Outfit Application for Character Portraits
member_descriptions.description: Upload your character portrait and outfit reference. Generate a new portrait with the specific outfit applied for consistent wardrobe control. Affordable alternative to Nano Banana Pro and Nano Banana 2.

member_descriptions.name: template_eric_thumbnail_generator
member_descriptions.title: YouTube Thumbnail Generator
member_descriptions.description: Generate high-contrast, clickable YouTube thumbnails using Nano Banana Pro. Creates dramatic compositions with exaggerated subjects and bold color strategies for maximum engagement.

member_descriptions.name: template_sferro21_product_ad.app
member_descriptions.title: Product Ad Cinematic Sequence Generator
member_descriptions.description: Upload a product image and a cinematic style reference. Generate a sequence of stylized product advertisements with consistent composition and lighting.

member_descriptions.name: templates-1_input-multiple_styles_prompt.app
member_descriptions.title: 1 input multiple styles from prompt
member_descriptions.description: Upload an image and generate 12 stylized variations in under 15 seconds.

member_descriptions.name: templates-assemble_dieline
member_descriptions.title: Generate Brand Packaging from Dieline
member_descriptions.description: Upload a dieline of your product and assemble into a 3D package.

member_descriptions.name: templates-color_illustration
member_descriptions.title: Add Color to Line Art Illustration
member_descriptions.description: Input a black and white illustration and generate a colored output.

member_descriptions.name: templates-product_ad-v2.0
member_descriptions.title: Swap Product Into a Reference AD
member_descriptions.description: Create static ads for your product in the style of a reference advertisement

member_descriptions.name: templates-subject_holding_product.app
member_descriptions.title: Add Product to Character’s Hand, AI UGC
member_descriptions.description: Upload a photo of your character and your product. Generate an image of that character holding the product.

member_descriptions.name: templates-subject_product_swap.app
member_descriptions.title: Swap Product in Character’s Hand, UGC Style
member_descriptions.description: Upload a photo of a character holding a product and your brands product. Generate an image with the products swapped.

member_descriptions.name: templates_doc_workbox_poster_recreator
member_descriptions.title: Realistic Poster Redesign With Character Transformation
member_descriptions.description: Transform uploaded images into realistic poster designs. Change character poses, faces, and clothing while maintaining artistic style and color schemes. Outputs a visually impactful poster with artistic typography.

member_descriptions.name: templates_graphic_design_recomposer
member_descriptions.title: Graphic Design Recomposer
member_descriptions.description: Upload a graphic design and select your desired aspect ratio. Generates and recomposes the graphic to fit the new aspect ratio.

member_descriptions.name: utility_bria_increase_resolution
member_descriptions.title: Image Upscale: Bria Increase Resolution
member_descriptions.description: Upscale any image to higher resolutions using Bria's dedicated resolution enhancement API, which preserves original content without adding new details or regenerating the image. The workflow accepts a single input image and produces one enhanced, higher-resolution output, supporting JPEG and PNG files in RGB, RGBA, or CMYK color modes up to a maximum area of 8192x8192 pixels. Built-in content moderation scans both the input image and generated output to ensure safe, policy-compliant processing. Ideal for preparing images for print, enlarging photos for digital display, or increasing resolution of assets for professional design work.

member_descriptions.name: utility_bria_remove_image_background
member_descriptions.title: Remove Background: Bria
member_descriptions.description: Upload an image to automatically remove its background using the Bria API. The workflow processes the request asynchronously and returns the edited image with a transparent background.

member_descriptions.name: acescg_to_srgb
member_descriptions.description: [Local] OCIO color convert. 1 EXR (or PNG) in -> 1 PNG out. Loads via bepic_imageLoad (OIIO), applies bepic_colorTransform input ACES - ACEScg to output Output - sRGB with clamp on, saves 16-bit PNG via bEpic_imageSave (OIIO). It focuses on rendering expressive and artistic styles. Ideal for concept art exploration, visual brainstorming, and creating stylized imagery for design projects.

member_descriptions.name: image_krea2_turbo_t2i_int8
member_descriptions.title: Krea-2 Int8: Text to Image
member_descriptions.description: Generate images with the Krea-2 Turbo distilled text-to-image model using the high-performance Int8 Convrot format, which delivers better quality than FP8 while generally running faster across most GPUs. This workflow accepts no file inputs and produces a single image output, with optional style LoRA support for creative customization. Ideal for rapid concept art iteration, batch asset generation for games or marketing, and exploring the speed-quality sweet spot of the Convrot Int8 quantization.

member_descriptions.title: Pixal3D: Multi Views to 3D
member_descriptions.description: Upload your own separate view images, or use one mixed multi-view turnaround sheet. The workflow prepares front, back, left and right views, then reconstructs a textured 3D model with Pixal3D Multi-View.

member_descriptions.name: Image_capybara_v0_1_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: Capybara: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Upload an image or video and input a text instruction. Generate an edited output using the Capybara model for tasks like style changes, object replacement, or time-of-day adjustments.

member_descriptions.title: J_alpha_compositing

member_descriptions.title: J_alpha_compositing_api

member_descriptions.name: hidream_e1_1
member_descriptions.title: HiDream E1.1 Image Editing
member_descriptions.description: Edit images with HiDream E1.1-superior image quality and editing accuracy compared to HiDream-E1-Full.

member_descriptions.name: hidream_e1_full
member_descriptions.title: HiDream E1 Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit images with HiDream E1 - Professional natural language image editing model.

member_descriptions.name: image_boogu_image_0_1_edit
member_descriptions.title: Boogu image 0.1 Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit images using Boogu's instruction-driven model, taking one input image and generating an edited output alongside a side-by-side comparison view.

member_descriptions.name: image_boogu_image_0_1_edit_int8
member_descriptions.title: Boogu image 0.1 Edit Int8
member_descriptions.description: Edit images with the Boogu Image Edit model, now optimized with convrot int8 quantization for faster inference and better quality than fp8. This workflow takes 1 input image and produces 1 edited image output. Ideal for quick image edits, batch processing with improved performance, and users wanting to leverage the convrot int8 format's speed and quality advantages.

member_descriptions.name: image_chrono_edit_14B
member_descriptions.title: ChronoEdit 14B: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Image editing powered by video models' dynamic understanding, creating physically plausible results while preserving character and style consistency.

member_descriptions.name: image_fibo2_edit_dev_pe
member_descriptions.title: Fibo 2.0 Dev: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Same graph as the Turbo template loaded with the full non-distilled Fibo 2.0 Dev weights: 50 steps at CFG 5 with Bria's structured negative, for the cleanest edits when sampling time is not the constraint. The optional prompt enhancer rewrites the instruction into a structured caption; switch it off to sample the raw prompt.

member_descriptions.name: image_fibo2_edit_turbo_pe
member_descriptions.title: Fibo 2.0 Turbo: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit an image with local open-weights Fibo 2.0 Edit Turbo (int8) and an optional prompt enhancer: a local vision LLM reads the reference image and rewrites your instruction into the structured caption Fibo 2.0 was trained on before TextEncodeFibo2 samples 4 steps at CFG 1. Switch the enhancer off to feed your raw prompt, and compare the result against the source in the built-in image compare node. Ideal for fast instruction-based retouches that keep identity and composition.

member_descriptions.name: image_hidream_o1
member_descriptions.title: HiDream O1 Full: Image generation
member_descriptions.description: Input a text prompt and optionally upload reference images. Generate a high-resolution image up to 2048x2048 with text-to-image, editing, or subject-driven personalization.

member_descriptions.name: image_hidream_o1_dev
member_descriptions.title: HiDream O1 Dev
member_descriptions.description: Input a text prompt and optional reference images. Generate a high-resolution image (up to 2048x2048) with support for text-to-image, image editing, and subject-driven personalization.

member_descriptions.name: image_joyai_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: JoyAI Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit images by following natural language instructions with JoyAI-Image-Edit, which leverages multimodal understanding for precise, spatially aware modifications. This workflow takes one reference image and produces one edited image output plus a side-by-side comparison view. Ideal for instruction-guided retouching, region-specific object replacement, and complex scene adjustments requiring relational grounding.

member_descriptions.name: image_mage_flow_edit_int8
member_descriptions.title: Mage-Flow-Edit: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit images by following natural language instructions with Mage-Flow-Edit, an instruction-based model that handles background replacement, style changes, localized edits, and restoration using up to three reference images. The workflow takes one input image and produces one edited output plus a side-by-side comparison view. Ideal for creative photo retouching, product image styling, and restoring old or damaged photos.

member_descriptions.name: image_mage_flow_edit_turbo_int8
member_descriptions.title: Mage-Flow-Edit Turbo: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit images using a reference photo and text instructions with the Mage-Flow-Edit Turbo model, a distilled 4B-parameter model that produces results in just 4 steps. It takes 1-3 reference images and a text prompt as input, then outputs an edited image matching your instructions. Ideal for quick style transfers, background replacements, and interactive photo editing sessions.

member_descriptions.name: image_ming_image_01_design_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: Ming Image 0.1 Design: Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit an existing image with Ming Image 0.1 Design, a 6B model tuned for UI, infographics, and posters. It takes one input image plus the boxes you draw on it - position, description, and colour palette - and rebuilds them into a layer-by-layer caption, returning one re-rendered image. Ideal for restaging a layout, poster-style re-renders, and turning a photograph into a designed composition.

member_descriptions.name: image_moss_image_base_t2i
member_descriptions.title: MOSS-Image Base: Text to Image
member_descriptions.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with the MOSS-Image base checkpoint, which reads a full scene caption and returns one finished image. The prompt upsampler expands a short request into that caption first. Use it for fine-tuning experiments and comparisons with the instruction-tuned checkpoint.

member_descriptions.name: image_moss_image_base_t2i_bboxes
member_descriptions.title: MOSS-Image Base: Layout-Guided Text to Image
member_descriptions.description: Generate an image from a text prompt plus a layout drawn in Create Bounding Boxes, using the MOSS-Image base checkpoint. Each box carries its own caption and text boxes render their text. Useful for comparing the base and instruction-tuned checkpoints on the same layout.

member_descriptions.name: image_moss_image_edit
member_descriptions.title: MOSS-Image: Image Edit LoRA
member_descriptions.description: Edit a photo with a short instruction using MOSS-Image and its edit LoRA: the instruction and the source image are encoded together, so the sampler redraws the same frame and only the described change is applied. Colour, material, outfit and background swaps keep the face, hair, pose and framing intact, and a Compare Images node shows the source next to the result.

member_descriptions.name: image_moss_image_t2i
member_descriptions.title: MOSS-Image: Text to Image
member_descriptions.description: Generate an image from a text prompt with MOSS-Image, an open-weights model that reads a full scene caption and returns one finished image. A prompt upsampler expands a short request into that caption first, so a one-line description is enough. Ideal for editorial photography, product shots, and concept art.

member_descriptions.name: image_moss_image_t2i_bboxes
member_descriptions.title: MOSS-Image: Layout-Guided Text to Image
member_descriptions.description: Generate an image from a text prompt plus a layout drawn in Create Bounding Boxes. Each box carries its own caption, and text boxes also render their text, so MOSS-Image places every element where you put it. Useful for posters, packaging shots, and any composition where placement matters.

member_descriptions.title: OmniGen2 Image Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit images with natural language instructions using OmniGen2's advanced image editing capabilities and text rendering support.

member_descriptions.name: Kling3_multiShot
member_descriptions.description: API multi-shot storyboard video via Kling 3.0 (kling-v3). 1 input image (start frame, LoadImage node) -> 1 video output (VHS_VideoCombine). Generates 1-6 sequential shots in a single generation: each shot has its own text prompt (max 512 chars) and duration set directly on the KlingVideoNode. Use for storyboards, scene sequences, and narrative clips with multiple camera cuts. Prompts go into multi_shot.storyboard_N_prompt inputs; multi_shot must match shot count exactly (e.g. '3 storyboards'). Aspect ratio defaults to 16:9, resolution to 720p - override only on explicit user request.

member_descriptions.name: api_heygen_video_translate
member_descriptions.title: HeyGen: Video Translate
member_descriptions.description: Translate video content into another language with full lip-sync using HeyGen Translate, which automatically transcribes speech, translates it, generates a cloned voice, and re-syncs mouth movements. Takes 1 input video and produces 1 output video. Ideal for localizing talking-head videos, dubbing multilingual presentations, and creating lip-synced content for global audiences.

member_descriptions.name: api_higgsfield_genjutsu_motion_transfer
member_descriptions.title: Higgsfield Genjutsu: Motion Transfer
member_descriptions.description: Recast an existing video with Higgsfield Genjutsu: the source clip keeps its motion, camera movement, timing and audio, while the cast, location and style are rebuilt from 1 to 8 reference images. Describe which reference replaces what in the optional prompt. Output length follows the source clip. Ideal for restyling footage, swapping the cast of a shot, and building scenes a shoot never covered.

member_descriptions.name: api_luma_ray3_2_video_edit
member_descriptions.title: Luma Ray 3.2: Video Edit
member_descriptions.description: Edit videos using natural language commands with Luma Ray 3.2, processing one input video and generating an edited output based on your textual instructions.

member_descriptions.name: api_runway_aleph2_video_edit
member_descriptions.title: Runway Aleph2: Video Edit
member_descriptions.description: Generate a single edited video that preserves original motion and timing while applying your chosen changes. Ideal for portrait and product relighting, consistent lighting across photo sets, and e-commerce apparel presentation.

member_descriptions.name: api_seedance2_5_video_editing
member_descriptions.title: Seedance2.5: Video Editing
member_descriptions.description: Edit existing video clips with Seedance 2.5 by describing changes in natural language, enabling local object removal, background swaps, scene replacements, and style transfers while preserving the original composition and motion. Feed in 1 video and receive 1 edited video output with temporally consistent results across frames. Ideal for e-commerce background replacement, stylized remakes of footage, and ad re-editing with targeted retouching.

member_descriptions.name: api_seedance2_5_video_extend
member_descriptions.title: Video Extend: Seedance 2.5
member_descriptions.description: Extend an existing video forward or backward by generating new segments that seamlessly preserve the original characters, scenes, and aspect ratio. The source video must be 1.9-30 seconds long, and you specify the duration of the new clip (4-30 seconds, default 5), with output delivered as MP4 or MOV. Ideal for continuing unfinished footage, creating extended narrative sequences, and building longer edit chains.

member_descriptions.name: api_seedance2_reference2v
member_descriptions.description: API reference-to-video via Seedance 2.0 (ByteDance). 1 reference image + 1 reference video -> 1 video output. Generates, edits, or extends video using multimodal references for subject consistency, video editing, and video extension.

member_descriptions.name: api_sync_so_lip_sync_video
member_descriptions.title: Sync 3: Video Lip-Sync
member_descriptions.description: Synchronize a video's lip movements with a new audio track using the Sync Labs sync-3 model, which automatically adjusts the speaker's mouth to match your uploaded audio. This workflow takes 1 video and 1 audio input to produce 1 synced video output. Ideal for dubbing foreign-language content, correcting mismatched dialogue in video production, or animating a static portrait to speak.

member_descriptions.name: api_veed_lipsync_2_0
member_descriptions.title: VEED Lipsync 2.0: Lip Sync
member_descriptions.description: Re-sync a speaker's mouth in footage you already shot to a new speech track with VEED Lipsync 2.0. The person on camera speaks the new audio while the rest of the shot stays as recorded; the output keeps the video's resolution at 25 fps and runs as long as the audio, up to 600 seconds. If the clip is shorter than the speech it plays forward and backward until the audio ends. Ideal for dubbing a line, swapping a script without re-shooting, or making localized versions of existing footage.

member_descriptions.name: api_veed_remove_video_background
member_descriptions.title: VEED Remove Video Background: Matte Export
member_descriptions.description: Cut the subject out of a video with VEED Remove Video Background: the node segments the foreground in every frame and returns the frames plus an alpha mask, and Join Image with Alpha turns that mask into a transparent PNG sequence ready to composite. Choose standard, fast or green-screen keying; clips up to 60 seconds.

member_descriptions.name: api_bytedance_seed_audio1_0_t2a
member_descriptions.title: Seed Audio 1.0: Text to Audio
member_descriptions.description: Input a text prompt to generate speech, dialogue, background music, and sound effects in one audio file. Describe voices, emotion, and scene details to create multi-speaker audio up to 2 minutes.

member_descriptions.name: api_bytedance_seed_audio1_0_ta2a
member_descriptions.title: Seed Audio 1.0: Text + Audio to Audio
member_descriptions.description: Upload a reference audio clip and write a text prompt to clone the voice into a new scene. Generate dialogue, background music, and sound effects with up to 3 reference voices.

member_descriptions.name: api_bytedance_seed_audio1_0_ti2a
member_descriptions.title: Seed Audio 1.0: Text + Image to Audio
member_descriptions.description: Upload a character image and write a text prompt to generate audio. The model derives the voice from your image, then produces speech, ambience, background music, and sound effects.

member_descriptions.name: api_elevenlabs_speech_to_speech
member_descriptions.title: ElevenLabs: Speech to Speech
member_descriptions.description: Upload a source audio file to apply a new voice tone or clone a different voice, generating a modified audio output.

member_descriptions.name: api_elevenlabs_text_to_dialogue
member_descriptions.title: ElevenLabs: Text to Dialogue
member_descriptions.description: Input text and select a voice profile to generate a high-quality, emotionally expressive audio dialogue.

member_descriptions.name: api_elevenlabs_text_to_sound_effects
member_descriptions.title: ElevenLabs: Text to Sound Effects
member_descriptions.description: Input a text prompt to generate custom sound effects and ambient audio.

member_descriptions.name: api_elevenlabs_text_to_speech
member_descriptions.title: ElevenLabs: Text to Speech
member_descriptions.description: Input text to generate speech with ultra-realistic voices, or upload a voice sample to clone it for synthesis.

member_descriptions.name: api_elevenlabs_v4_text_to_dialogue
member_descriptions.title: Eleven v4: Text to Dialogue
member_descriptions.description: Generate a multi-speaker dialogue from text with Eleven v4: give every entry its own line and its own voice, direct the delivery with audio tags such as [quietly] or [laughs], or clone a voice from a sample and let it take a turn. One audio file is output. Ideal for podcasts, game dialogue, and character conversations.

member_descriptions.name: api_elevenlabs_v4_text_to_speech
member_descriptions.title: Eleven v4: Text to Speech
member_descriptions.description: Generate expressive speech from text with Eleven v4, the quality-focused ElevenLabs model. Direct the performance with audio tags such as [whispers] or [excited] written into the script, or upload a voice sample to clone a voice and narrate the script in it. One audio file is output. Ideal for audiobooks, narration, and character voiceovers.

member_descriptions.name: api_elevenlabs_voice_isolation
member_descriptions.title: ElevenLabs: Voice Isolation
member_descriptions.description: Upload an audio file containing background noise. Use the ElevenLabs API to isolate and output a clean voice track.

member_descriptions.name: api_fishaudio_drama3_dialogue
member_descriptions.title: Fish Audio Drama 3: Two-Speaker Dialogue
member_descriptions.description: Generate a multi-speaker scene in one pass with Fish Audio Drama 3: connect one Voice Selector per speaker, mark speaker changes with @Voice1 / @Voice2, and direct the delivery with plain-language [directions] and <whisper> word tags.

member_descriptions.name: api_fishaudio_drama3_directed
member_descriptions.title: Fish Audio Drama 3: Directed Performance
member_descriptions.description: Direct a single Fish Audio Drama 3 performance from the text: shift the delivery mid-line with [plain-language directions] and wrap words with <whisper>...</whisper> tags.

member_descriptions.name: api_fishaudio_speech_to_text
member_descriptions.title: Fish Audio: Speech to Text
member_descriptions.description: Transcribe audio to text with Fish Audio ASR. Language is detected automatically across 80+ languages, with optional word-level timestamps returned as JSON segments. Use it to create subtitles, transcribe recordings, or generate text prompts from audio clips. A sample audio is pre-loaded so you can test it right away.

member_descriptions.name: api_fishaudio_text_to_speech
member_descriptions.title: Fish Audio: Text to Speech
member_descriptions.description: Generate natural, expressive speech from text with Fish Audio S2 Pro, a text-to-speech model supporting 80+ languages and fine-grained control over emotion, tone, and pacing using inline tags like [whisper] or [excited]. Input your text and receive one high-quality audio output, with optional style tags woven directly into the script. Ideal for voiceover production, multilingual content creation, and character dialogue in games or animations.

member_descriptions.name: api_fishaudio_voice_clone_tts
member_descriptions.title: Fish Audio: Voice Clone to Speech
member_descriptions.description: Clone any voice from a short recording, then use it to speak any script with Fish Audio. Record 2-3 clips of 15-20 seconds, connect them to the Instant Voice Clone node, and the cloned voice feeds straight into text to speech with no training wait. Add emotion tags to control how your cloned voice delivers each line. Great for personalized narration, character voices, and content in your own voice.

member_descriptions.name: api_heygen_text_to_speech
member_descriptions.title: HeyGen: Text to Speech
member_descriptions.description: Generate natural-sounding speech from text using HeyGen's advanced TTS engine, supporting a wide range of languages and accents with customizable voices. Input your text and select from numerous preset voices or clone a custom voice from a short audio sample. Ideal for creating voiceovers for videos, generating multilingual narration, and producing personalized audio content.

member_descriptions.name: api_heygen_voice_1
member_descriptions.title: HeyGen Voice 1.0: Voice Clone to Speech
member_descriptions.description: Clone a voice from a short recording with HeyGen Voice 1.0, then speak any script in that voice. Connect one audio clip to Instant Clone and the resulting voice_id feeds straight into text to speech, with no training wait. Use the expressiveness control to stay close to the recording or push more emotion into the delivery. Ideal for narration in your own voice, character dialogue, and multilingual voiceover.

member_descriptions.name: api_heygen_voice_1_turbo
member_descriptions.title: HeyGen Voice 1.0 Turbo: Voice Clone to Speech
member_descriptions.description: Clone a voice from a short recording with HeyGen Voice 1.0 Turbo, then speak any script in that voice. It is the same instant clone as Voice 1.0, run through the turbo model, which renders faster for quick drafts and iteration. Connect one audio clip to Instant Clone and the resulting voice_id feeds straight into text to speech, while SaveText keeps the ID on disk for the next session. Ideal for narration in your own voice, character dialogue, and multilingual voiceover.

member_descriptions.name: api_mirelo_text_to_sfx
member_descriptions.title: Mirelo SFX 2.0: Text to SFX
member_descriptions.description: Generate sound effects from a text prompt with Mirelo sfx-2.0: name the sound, its material, space and intensity in one line and get a 48 kHz mono audio file, up to 10 minutes.

member_descriptions.name: api_mirelo_video_to_sfx
member_descriptions.title: Mirelo SFX 2.0: Video to SFX
member_descriptions.description: Add picture-locked sound effects to a clip with Mirelo sfx-2.0: the model watches the video and times Foley to on-screen action, keeps speech by default, and saves the SFX track, the speech track and the video carrying the new mix.

member_descriptions.name: api_sonilo_t2m
member_descriptions.title: Sonilo: Text to Music Generation
member_descriptions.description: Generate high-quality, production-ready music from text prompts. Input descriptive text to create original soundtracks with streaming playback and precise duration control.

member_descriptions.name: api_sonilo_v2m
member_descriptions.title: Sonilo: Video Soundtrack Generation
member_descriptions.description: Generate synchronized soundtracks from video footage. Input a video to produce music that matches its pacing and emotional cues, outputting a perfectly timed audio file.

member_descriptions.name: api_veed_clean_audio
member_descriptions.title: VEED Clean Audio: Speech Cleanup
member_descriptions.description: Remove background noise from a speech recording with VEED Clean Audio: music and effects go with the noise, pauses are cleaned completely, and the voice comes back as 48 kHz mono audio, optionally normalized to a target loudness. Audio up to 1799 seconds.

member_descriptions.name: api_veed_clean_audio_video
member_descriptions.title: VEED Clean Audio: Video Speech Cleanup
member_descriptions.description: Clean the speech inside a video with VEED Clean Audio: background noise, music and effects are stripped from the soundtrack, pauses are cleaned completely, and the clip comes back with 48 kHz mono speech, optionally normalized to a target loudness while the picture stays as shot. Video up to 1799 seconds.

member_descriptions.name: api_seedance2_5_draft_i2v
member_descriptions.title: Seedance2.5 Draft: Image to Video
member_descriptions.description: Generate draft preview videos from a first frame image using Seedance 2.5's two-phase draft mode: stage one turns your image into a fast, low-cost 480p preview plus a reusable draft task ID, and stage two renders the 1080p final from that ID. Ideal for testing motion, camera and scene ideas on a still before committing to a full-quality render.

member_descriptions.name: api_seedance2_5_flf2v
member_descriptions.title: Seedance 2.5: FLF2V
member_descriptions.description: Generate a smooth video transition between a user-provided start frame and end frame with Seedance 2.5, which automatically interpolates the motion, camera movement, and visual evolution while locking both endpoints. Ideal for shot transitions, storyboard previz, and before-and-after scene showcases like empty-to-packed or day-to-night shifts.

member_descriptions.name: api_seedance2_i2v_flf
member_descriptions.description: API first-last-frame-to-video via Seedance 2.0 (ByteDance). 1 first frame image + 1 optional last frame image -> 1 video output. Generates video interpolated between keyframes with precise motion control.

member_descriptions.name: api_minimax_h3_max_flf2v

member_descriptions.description: Generate polished, prompt-faithful videos faster than real time with MiniMax H3 Max, a post-trained model tuned for stronger prompt adherence and vivid cinematic aesthetics. member_descriptions.name: api_minimax_h3_max_i2v

The model delivers faster-than-real-time generation with strong prompt adherence and polished cinematic aesthetics. Ideal for bringing character art to life, animating product shots, and creating motion from concept images.

Ideal for improving UGC clips, refining AIGC content, and restoring classic films with vibrant, clear results.

member_descriptions.name: api_clarity_ai_crystal_upscale
member_descriptions.title: Clarity AI: Crystal Upscaler
member_descriptions.description: Upscale and enhance images with the precision-focused Crystal model, preserving real detail while adding resolution. Takes one image in and returns one upscaled image plus a side-by-side comparison view. Ideal for portraits, product shots, and print-ready enlargements where faithful detail matters.

member_descriptions.name: api_clarity_ai_crystal_video_upscale
member_descriptions.title: Clarity AI: Crystal Video Upscaler
member_descriptions.description: Upscale a video with Clarity AI's Crystal model, running through the Fal proxy: one video in, one upscaled video out. Set scale_factor to multiply the frame size, and the output keeps the source resolution, frame count and audio track. The result is capped at 9 megapixels per frame and 360 megapixel-seconds per clip, so long or oversized clips come back upscaled by less than the factor you asked for. Ideal for restoring generated clips, preparing footage for large screens, and sharpening soft AI video.
